shortDescription: Manages servers on VSP E series, VSP One Block 20 series, and VSP One Block 80 series storage systems.

options.name: connection_info
options.description: Information required to establish a connection to the storage system.

options.name: spec
options.description: Configuration parameters for the server operation.

options.name: state
options.description: Defines the server operation type. Available options include C(present), C(absent), C(sync_server_nick_name), C(sync_server_nickname), C(add_host_groups), C(add_hba), C(remove_hba), C(add_path), and C(remove_path). C(sync_server_nick_name) will be deprecated in favor of C(sync_server_nickname).
